_about: PROPOSAL (Sal, 2026-10-31). Read by nothing yet; the crop table for the farming code (FARMING_SPEC.md). 12 crops. grow_days = game days sowing to ripe, water_per_day = buckets per bed per game day (0 if rain-fed), seed_source = the wild plant that gives seeds so a player starts from forage, store = how it keeps (drying, salting, root cellar). Agronomy numbers (days to maturity, soil, storage) are general growing knowledge for temperate crops, approximate and not individually sourced; a game day is one real hour so real months are scaled down by the code owner. Items for all 12 crops and their seeds exist (332 to 337 and 374 to 385); the wild-seed drops, the cellar and the drying rack do not. 2026-10-31 audit against Tyler's farming rules: the server compares `sow_season` to the current season as ONE string (turnip is hard-coded as always sowable), and a new world starts on day 100, early summer, so spring-only crops could not be sown for 265 real hours. `sow_season` is now the single season the code accepts (summer for nearly all crops except wheat and barley, which stay spring because test_farming sows them in spring: a summer-start player grows oats and the vegetables first; so a new player can plant on day 1; rye autumn; turnip spring but exempt) and `sow_seasons` keeps the realistic list (wheat spring and summer, rye autumn, turnip spring and autumn...) for when the code accepts a list. 2026-10-31 pace rebalance (moderator): grow_days are game days = real hours. Fast 4 to 6 h (radish 4, lettuce 5, turnip 5, peas 6), mid 8 to 16 h (beet 8, carrot 10, oats 12, cabbage 14, onion 16), slow 20 to 30 h (barley 20, flax 22, potato 24, rye 28, wheat 30). A game year is 365 real hours, a season about 91, so a crop sown in its season ripens inside it or the next. Water need (water_per_day x grow_days wet days) is unchanged in proportion: wheat 9 wet days of 30, radish 2 of 4.

moisture.note: Plot moisture (buildables plan B5, Morgan 10 Nov 2026; Sonny's water rules section 8): every tilled bed and garden plot holds 0 to 100 percent of a soil store of store_mm (a 2 x 2 plot: 25 mm = 100 L, so one 8 L bucket = pour_pct). Heavy rain (rain_heavy) fills it; lighter rain (rain_any) adds rain_gain_pct_per_day x rain; dry weather takes the weather's evaporation, cool_mm a day at cool_c up to hot_mm at hot_c (less below freezing, x (1 + wind_x x wind)), times the structure's moisture_factor (framed beds hold water). A new bed starts at start_pct. A crop's day is wet when its bed holds wet_min_pct or more. src/shared/plot_water.gd.
moisture.pour_ml_note: PROVISIONAL (GOALS-REPAIR A-3): pour_pct is one 8 L bucket (see the note above), so a pour from filled containers adds pour_pct x (mL poured / pour_ml), up to pour_ml (8000 mL) a bed a game day. Precedent: this file's own note (one 8 L bucket = pour_pct) and items.json bucket capacity_ml 8000. Not approved by Dave.

storage_chain.drying: Drying rack (new structure, 4 sticks + twine 4): berries, herbs, peas, meat strips; item Jerky = raw meat 2 + salt 1 on the rack
storage_chain.salting: Salt (sea salt, WATER_GATHER_SPEC.md) + fish or meat into a clay jug: Salted fish, Salted meat
storage_chain.root_cellar: Root cellar (dug room, needs 24 stone + 6 lumber, hammer blueprint): root crops keep 4 to 6 months, spoilage x0.25
storage_chain.ferment: Cabbage + salt in a jug: sauerkraut keeps 6 months (needs salt)

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.seed_source: wild tall grass in grassland, late summer (1 to 3 seeds)
wheat.store: dry in the sheaf, grain keeps 12 months in a dry store

barley.name: Barley
barley.store: dry grain keeps 12 months; also malting and ale later

oats.seed_source: wild grass on heath and boreal edges

rye.name: Rye
rye.seed_source: wild grass in dry grassland, autumn
rye.store: dry grain keeps 12 months; sown in autumn, overwinters

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.store: root cellar: keeps 4 to 5 months cool and dark

potato.name: Potato
potato.seed_source: dig a wild tuber with a spade
potato.store: root cellar: keeps 5 to 6 months in the dark

cabbage.name: Cabbage
cabbage.seed_source: wild sea cabbage on beaches, summer
cabbage.store: cellar 3 to 4 months, or salted into a ferment (needs sea salt)

onion.name: Onion
onion.seed_source: wild garlic and wild leek bulbs, spring (nearest wild source)

peas.name: Peas
peas.store: dry the pods: keeps 12 months; fresh only a few days
